page.layout: One text column in the centre of the page, with short marginal notes in the left margin beside the second and third paragraphs. Running head and page number at the top. A catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: concordia in Ecclesiastica administratione omnes Christi Ministri conspirent; neve extra legitimorum Pastorum caulam, quisquam Dominicas oves colligat. Non hoc à tuis Apostolis, Turriane, Cornelius, Cyprianusque didicerant; sed ab ipsis potius tui illi post eos jam dudum mortuos nati Apostoli id hauserunt atque expresserunt.

a c.13. p. 35. recte.Idem est Jesuitę {a}a lusus in iis, quae ex Synodis quarto sæculo habitis adfert. Patres (inquit) Nicæni statuunt, siquis se ipsum exciderit, ne in clerum admittatur. Nic. 6. 1.Quos vero barbari, aut Domini castraverrunt, si inveniuntur alias digni, tales ad clerum τὸν κανόνα regulam suscipere. Idem autem in Canonum Apostolicorum syllogę decernitur; canonibus 20. 21. & 22. Ergo cognita fuit Nicænis Patribus hæc sylloge; & quam memorant regulam, ea nihil aliud significat, quam ipsos illos Apostolorum canones. Ego vero hoc ex illo sequi nego. Illud quidem hinc haberi fateor, fuisse jam ante Nicenæ Synodi tempora aliquam in Ecclesia regulam; ex qua hæc ita administrarentur; Eam regulam ab ipsis Apostolis ita diserte constitutam fuisse, vel a Clemente litteris mandatam, & in istam, quam Turrianus defendit, syllogen relatam; nego hinc, nego ex ullo veteri

page.notes: The note letter "a" in the text ("Jesuitę a lusus") is a reference mark; its note is "a c.13. p. 35. recte." in the left margin. The Greek phrase τὸν κανόνα is printed in the text and is uncertain in its accents. The catchword "veteri" is right-aligned below the last line.
